elements.name: q_1
elements.title: Which example is live audio-only?
choices: A live audio stream without video or interaction

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: Why is an agenda alone insufficient?
choices: It may omit the actual discussion and decisions

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: What should be checked when callers participate?
choices: Caller audio reaches the transcription workflow

answer_key.q_1: A live audio stream without video or interaction
answer_key.q_2: It may omit the actual discussion and decisions
answer_key.q_3: Caller audio reaches the transcription workflow

explanations.q_1: Audio-only contains audio without video or interaction.
explanations.q_2: The alternative needs equivalent information from the event.
explanations.q_3: The alternative must convey callers’ relevant contributions.
